scenario: No throwaway/unused captures per LREG.10.4 — the design decision is that captures must be bound; non-capturing groups `(?:...)` are the correct way to group without binding. Pin: `(?:...)` non-capturing group in a where-clause pattern compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /(?:ERROR|WARN):/
->
    log info "found"
